tbesh_html:
1) Nethinims
1a) temple slaves assigned to the Levites and priests for service in the sanctuary
Aramaic equivalent: ne.tin (נְתִין "temple servant" H5412)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: the Nethinim, or Temple-servants (as given to that duty)
strongs_1890.derivation: or נָתוּן (Ezra 8:17), (the proper form as passive participle), from H5414 (נָתַן); one given, i.e. (in the plural only)
